thread:
Asha (CS): Quick week0 smoke for SagePoint private deploy. High level: network & IAM are OK, two open items: (1) audit logs lack request session details, (2) KMS rotation failed due to alias mismatch. Tagging @Kai and @Liam to triage. I'll capture actions and renewal risk if not cleared by Friday EOW. :wave:

Kai (Platform): Can you paste the log sample and the exact rotation error? I want to reproduce locally.

Asha (CS): Sample log snippet (redacted):
  - eventTime: 2026-02-14T09:12:34Z
  - eventName: StartInstances
  - userIdentity: type=AssumedRole arn=arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/SagePointCrossAcct/DeployRole  // expected sessionContext missing
  - requestParameters: {}

  Rotation error from run: "Error: KMS alias \"alias/sagepoint-prod-enc\" not found". Actual alias in acct: alias/sagepoint-prod-enc-2025 (automation expects short alias).

Liam (Security): The missing sessionContext points to either CloudTrail delivery settings or the log delivery pipeline stripping session info. Please confirm CloudTrail is set to include management events and global service events; also check the delivery role's permissions and whether any intermediate collector (Fluentd/Splunk forwarder) is dropping fields.

Kai (Platform): Ran the local smoke mirror: DeployBot shows 18/20 checks passed; failures: kms alias and audit fields. DeployBot output: smoke-suite - FAILED (2). Artifacts at https://artifacts.redwood/sagepoint/week0/1785059000. Also saw a network note: egress to Splunk collector required TLS SNI; I opened a temporary exception on the private gateway.

DeployBot: smoke-runner: 1785059000 | checks: network:ok iam:ok kms:fail audit:fail -- artifact link above.

Asha (CS): Proposed plan: (A) Kai to update rotation script to accept date-suffixed aliases and add a validation/fallback; (B) Liam to validate CloudTrail & delivery role and confirm whether sessionContext is preserved end-to-end; (C) If both unresolved by Friday 18:00 PT, label a medium renewal risk and schedule a customer solutions call next Tue.

Kai (Platform): I'll push a quick patch (rotation v0.1) by EOD and add a fallback alias matcher plus a unit test to prevent regressions.

Liam (Security): I'll audit the CloudTrail settings and the log-delivery pipeline today. If ingestion is dropping sessionContext, we'll update the onboarding runbook to require includeManagementEvents=true and explicit passthrough of sessionContext. Expect findings by tomorrow noon.

Asha (CS): I'll DM the SagePoint ops team a concise summary and request read-only slack link to their logging account if needed. Also marking renewal watch: unresolved after Friday => escalation. :triangular_flag_on_post:

Kai (Platform): Note: temporary gateway exception for Splunk egress is applied; will revert once collection verifies TLS SNI.

Liam (Security): Fine with the plan. If CloudTrail is misconfigured on their side we should surface remediation steps and consider a post-cutover checklist item so this doesn't recur.

Asha (CS): Scheduled 30m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to review patches and artifacts. I'll create JIRA tasks for these actions and capture the runbook updates.

DeployBot: reminder: weekly-health-scan scheduled for 2026-02-16T15:00:00Z

Asha (CS): Closing notes: tagging this thread as week0-health in the customer folder and adding SagePoint to the renewal-watchlist until the two items are cleared. Thanks team.
